articles.summary: Aptiv Accelerates Robotics Expansion With Industry Partners Deepens Collaboration with TARS and Shanghai Electric for Robotics Technology Integration and Application Into Manufacturing Operations SHANGHAI, China - November 6, 2026 Aptiv (NYSE: APTV), a global industrial technology company, signed separate strategic collaboration agreements with TARS and Shanghai Electric during the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE), expanding Aptivs presence in physical AI solutions for industrial applications. The partnerships bring robots into Aptivs manufacturing operations while integrating Aptiv products and technologies into new robotic platforms. Real-world manufacturing environments are critical to the development and commercialization of physical AI technologies. Aptiv brings extensive manufacturing, engineering and production expertise to help validate and refine these technologies. Hundreds of robots from TARS and Shanghai Electric are being gradually deployed
